column1: # The neutral compose corpus: 259 files, one per repository, sampled across 733.
# Every figure in docs/DOCKER-COMPAT.md and docs/RUNTIME-PARITY.md is measured on it.
# It is listed rather than vendored: the files are other people's, and a copy in this
# repo would be a redistribution nobody asked for. Each row is enough to fetch it back.
# THE COMMIT IS NOT PINNED. The corpus was sampled by repository and path, not by
# revision, so a file may have changed or vanished since. That is a real limit on
# reproducing these numbers exactly, and it is written here rather than discovered:
# the sha256 prefix of the bytes measured is the only thing that pins what was read.
